name: geode-drive-backup
description: Backup, not sync. Push your Obsidian vault to Google Drive and pull it back on a new device, with optional client-side encryption.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/tsconfig.json
scripts.version: node tools/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
